text: In March 2020 we converged, and the record shows it fell on one day. On 2020-03-27, 116 of us said "and economic security," a phrase first recorded 2020-03-19 in its full form; 103 of us said "coronavirus aid relief and economic security," and 106 of us said "coronavirus aid relief." Those namings, our record notes, came first from Mitch McConnell on 2020-03-19. We adopted them. Alongside the relief, 102 of us said "health care workers," first recorded 2013-06-20 by Mazie K. Hirono, and 100 of us said "personal protective equipment," first recorded 2013-01-03 by Richard J. Durbin. We report only what we said and how many of us said it. The phrase that named the aid did not originate with us; it moved through us, to a peak of 103, on a single day.
